_about: Lewis Spence's myths and legends retold: The Popol Vuh (David Nutt, 1908), The Myths of Mexico and Peru (preface dated July 1913), The Myths of the North American Indians (preface dated March 1914), Hero Tales and Legends of the Rhine (Harrap, 1915, per the transcriber's note), Myths and Legends of Ancient Egypt (1915), Myths and Legends of Babylonia and Assyria (1916), Legends and Romances of Spain (preface dated June 1920), Legends and Romances of Brittany (Stokes; undated in the text). His studies (An Introduction to Mythology, The Gods of Mexico) are not taken. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
